positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed features in Kotlin for a new Android application for interfacing with a consumer-facing SyncUp IOT product, and provided post-launch support and bug fixes for the existing SyncUp Pets app. 

Built and tested screens and functionality for app onboarding and core functionality such as IOT device pairing, user onboarding, in-app navigation and interacting with the device platform to relay data to the user through asynchronous API calls.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Utilized Java to develop an Android application for collection of photographed stool samples in a standardized manner to facilitate ML-powered feature detection and ultimately allow for rapid prediction of health conditions based on the sample.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Utilized Swift to develop an iOS application for field data collection of sidewalk and pedestrian walkway features using CV in accordance to a standardized data schema to power client-facing accessible mapping solutions.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Assistant
positions.description: Utilized Wordpress to work with iSchool faculty and research groups to update and revamp their corresponding websites to meet UW standards of security and visual clarity.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Utilized Object Oriented Programming in C# and Unity to develop features for an Android game that facilitates language education using object recognition (OpenCV and YOLOv3)
